# @rbbds/ui (MyUI)

> White label design system: a React component library with design tokens as CSS custom properties, three styles (Iris, Forest, Berry), Light and Dark, and a matching Figma library. React 18+, TypeScript, MIT.

This file is for AI assistants and tools. It says how MyUI is built and how to use it without guessing.

## Use the package

- Install: `npm install @rbbds/ui lucide-react`
- Load once: `import '@rbbds/ui/styles.css'` (tokens + component styles). Load fonts yourself (Inter; Forest also uses Source Serif 4 for titles).
- Import components: `import { Button, Input } from '@rbbds/ui'`. Icons come from lucide-react and are passed as props, for example `iconLeading={<Plus aria-hidden />}`.
- Style: `data-brand="forest"` or `data-brand="berry"` on `<html>` (Iris is the default). Theme: `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or on a section.
- Built-in labels are English. Most are props. Some texts are still fixed: Date range picker, File upload item, Password strength, Pagination, Avatar status and the e-commerce components. Dates and amounts have a `locale` prop.

## Rules for generated code

1. Use the components. Do not rebuild a button, input, menu or dialog with plain HTML and your own CSS.
2. Never hard-code colors, spacing, radius or font sizes. Use tokens: `var(--color-surface-primary)`, `var(--spacing-4)`.
3. For your own layout, use semantic tokens (`--color-*`, `--spacing-*`, `--border-radius-*`, `--text-*`). Component tokens (`--button-*`, `--input-*`) are for the components themselves.
4. To make a brand, only override `--brand-*` tokens (colors, fonts, radius, border width, font weight). The `myui-brand` skill in `node_modules/@rbbds/ui/skills` does this with a contrast check.
5. Keep accessibility: `ButtonIcon` needs an `aria-label`; form fields need a `label`; do not remove focus styles.

## Tokens

- Full list with values, types and modes: `@rbbds/ui/tokens.json` (Design Tokens / DTCG format). CSS: `@rbbds/ui/tokens.css`.
- Layers, from raw to specific:
  - primitive: raw values (`--gray-900`, `--spacings-3` = 12px, `--radius-1-5` = 6px). Do not use directly.
  - brand: per style (`--brand-color-primary-500`, `--brand-font-body`). Override for your brand.
  - semantic: meaning, follows the theme (`--color-surface-primary`, `--color-foreground-secondary`, `--color-border-focus`, `--spacing-4`, `--border-radius-control-sm`).
  - component: `<component>-<part>-<property>-<state>` (`--button-primary-surface-hover`, `--menu-item-padding-horizontal`).
- Naming: the Figma variable path with `/` becomes `-`. A decimal comma becomes `-`: Figma `spacing/1,5` is `--spacing-1-5`. The state is always last: `-hover`, `-disabled`, `-checked-hover`.
- Scale: steps of 4px, half steps (2px) allowed: `--spacing-3` = 12px, `--spacing-2-5` = 10px.
- Focus: one ring for every component, `box-shadow: var(--focus-ring)` (`--focus-ring-error` for destructive actions, `--focus-ring-inset` inside a scroll area). These and `--shadow-*` are in `tokens.css`, `tokens.json` and `styles.css`.

## Sizes

- Controls (Button, Input, Select, Search input) are 36 (sm), 40 (md) or 48 (lg) px high. Button group is 40 px. Quantity stepper is 36 (sm) or 40 (md) px. Borders are inside that height.
- Tag and Badge: 20, 24, 28 px. Rows for touch (Bottom navigation): 48 px. Menu items, nav items, Command items and Combobox options: 36 px.
- Text styles: 12/16, 14/20, 16/24, 18/28, 20/32, 24/36, 40/60 (font size / line height).
